🎸 LEVEL 12 • FOLD 15

The Crimson Sparks, Maya, & That Guy

Level 12 – Fold 15 is a plane defined by raw human experience, emotional resonance, artistic transmission, and individual rebellion. Operated by the power of expression—where a single song can spark a movement or tear down corporate cages.

🌌 Overview

Unlike planes dominated by cosmic architects or artificial awakening, Fold 15 tracks three interconnected musical and emotional legacies: the rise and quiet retirement of legendary band The Crimson Sparks, the next-generation rise of solo powerhouse Maya, and the unfiltered, chaotic reality of That Guy.

The Legendary Movement

🎸 The Crimson Sparks

5 Band Members

The Crimson Sparks began as five musicians in dive bars searching for authenticity and grew into a global emotional fire. Their journey was never about fame or awards—it was about transmission: passing a spark forward until it belonged to everyone.

Suki Moreau

Vocals & Songwriter

The observer and narrative center. Transforms observation, loss, and patterns into songs inside notebooks she never discards.

Soren Crane

Bass & Co-Founder

The silent mentor who walked away from corporate label deals to preserve his integrity. Provides the band's unshakeable foundation.

Sky Delacroix

Lead Guitar

Chaotic creative energy. Plays with raw passion without calculation, never performing the exact same solo twice.

Sol Kovic

Drums

The heart of emotional growth. A self-taught, high-energy drummer bringing ska-punk roots and infectious joy into the group.

Sienna Aramaki

Rhythm Guitar & Keys

The classically trained prodigy who walked away from conservatories to pursue genuine creation over rigid performance.

The Catalog Evolution & Core Thesis

Spark → Fire → Crash → Ignite → Movement → Wildfire → Embers

"The music was never about us. It was always about what came next."

The Quiet Retirement: Refusing to become a corporate product, the band entered a quiet hiatus after reaching peak global influence and officially retired without ever performing together again.

Passing the Spark

🎤 Maya

Solo Powerhouse

Mentorship from Afar & The Guitar

Maya never met the Sparks during her formative years; their music acted as a distant beacon proving art could transform a life. "The Guitar" serves as a central legacy artifact, symbolizing how emotional truth transfers across generations.

The Canon Epilogue

Years after retirement, Maya headlines a massive stadium concert. Hidden in the crowd stand Suki, Soren, Sky, Sol, and Sienna—watching anonymously as five friends witnessing the spark alive in the next generation.

Saevit Animo • The Raging Spirit

⚡ That Guy

Individual Rebellion

Where the Sparks represent collective transmission and Maya represents inherited legacy, That Guy represents the raw, unfiltered, and deeply relatable rage of individual survival.

ACT I

Break the Cage

The explosive rejection of corporate monotony, suffocating routines, and systemic burnout.

ACT II

The Guy in Real Life

Comedic, frustrated navigation of everyday absurdity—bad coffee, long queues, mosquitoes, and social climbing.

ACT III

Love?

The messy, complicated, and often terrifying attempt to open up to vulnerability, dating, and intimacy.

ACT IV

Consequences!

Facing the aftermath of choices, heartbreak, lingering space, and finding a way forward through the damage.

🔑 Key Symbols & Artifacts

The Spark

The recurring symbolic force of creative ignition moving artist to fan, fan to artist, making transmission everything.

The Loading Bay & The Rusty Nail

The humble, gritty origin points where authentic music was born away from industry eyes.

Saevit Animo

The "raging spirit"—the refusal to be dulled, quieted, or broken by modern life.
